_comment: The kamehameha's head. One drawing and two flights — level, and climbing out of the up-angled pose — because how a bolt travels is a fact about the bolt; the move only names which of them it wants (`fires.state`). The engine takes it away when it connects or runs out of stage. It is the same drawing at every charge level — how big it comes out is decided by the move that fires it (`fires.size`), and the hit box grows with the drawing because both are placed through the entity's scale.
